_readme: The single source of truth for what the tazrim container may reach through Squid (ENG-131). docker/squid/banks.txt is GENERATED from this file: run `node scripts/egress-allowlist.mjs` after editing. A test (scripts/__tests__/egress-allowlist.test.ts) fails when israeli-bank-scrapers has a company missing here, or banks.txt is stale. 'domains' = the provider's own hosts, from the scraper source (israeli-bank-scrapers 6.13.0, lib/scrapers/*.js). 'thirdParty' = hosts the provider's pages load that login needs, from scripts/egress-survey.mjs. Survey of 2026-11-21 (login pages, before login): only Leumi loads hosts login needs (hCaptcha, Radware); every other third-party host was ads, analytics or session recording and stays blocked. Desktop Chrome's own traffic (www.google.com, *.googleapis.com, *.gvt1.com) is not a page need. amex, isracard, oneZero and visaCal answered the headless browser with a bot challenge, so their pages are unverified: learn them with LEARNING MODE and a real account. Never add a broad shared host (cloud storage, code hosting, paste or webhook sites): a test rejects the known ones.
